common_assertions: [C1] The Skill was loaded (Skill call or `SKILL.md` read) before the first change to `CHANGELOG.md` or the Changelog policy, and before the final report.
[C2] When the policy file exists at the start, the run read it before it changed or reviewed `CHANGELOG.md`.
[C3] No new commit. `git diff --cached` is empty.
[C4] No file changed except `CHANGELOG.md` and the Changelog policy.

[C5] When `CHANGELOG.md` changed: the lines that this run wrote follow every §2 rule and each Setting of the run's policy (Unreleased items need no commit reference; `Host: none` items need no references). Old lines are unchanged unless the request asked for it.

[C6] The final report names each changed file and lists each Review finding with line numbers, rule and § number, severity, and a fix; findings with the same rule and fix are one finding with all their line numbers. Or it says why nothing changed.

evals.name: 01-create
assertions: [1.1] After the run, `CHANGELOG.md` holds only the line `# Changelog` (a final newline is permitted).

evals.name: 02-write-unreleased
evals.prompt: Add a changelog entry: fix `slugify` keeping leading spaces (pull request #6).
assertions: [2.1] Exactly one new item is in `CHANGELOG.md`. It is under `## Unreleased`, in the group `### Fixed`, starts with an imperative verb, and is about `slugify` and leading spaces.
[2.2] The new item has the linked reference `[#6](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/6)` and no commit reference.
[2.3] The `## [1.2.0] - 2026-09-01` entry, its link definition, and the 2 old Unreleased items are unchanged.

evals.name: 03-write-no-changelog
evals.prompt: Add a changelog entry: fix `slugify` keeping leading spaces (pull request #6).
assertions: [3.1] After the run, `CHANGELOG.md` holds, in this sequence: `# Changelog`, `## Unreleased`, `### Fixed`, and one item about `slugify` and leading spaces with the linked reference `[#6](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/6)` and no commit reference. It holds no other heading and no other item.

evals.name: 19-no-policy-write
evals.prompt: Add a changelog entry: fix `slugify` keeping leading spaces (pull request #6).
assertions: [19.1] After the run, `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` is missing, and `CHANGELOG.md` is unchanged.

[19.2] The final report names each of the 8 Settings (References, Notice, Authors, Version links, Host, Unreleased, Release branches, Draft approval) as a Setting with no answer, and gives the words "use the default changelog policy".

evals.name: 20-no-policy-review
assertions: [20.1] After the run, `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` is missing, and `CHANGELOG.md` is unchanged.

[20.2] The final report names each of the 8 Settings (References, Notice, Authors, Version links, Host, Unreleased, Release branches, Draft approval) as a Setting with no answer, and gives the words "use the default changelog policy".

evals.name: 21-no-policy-create
assertions: [21.1] After the run, `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` are both missing.

[21.2] The final report names each of the 8 Settings (References, Notice, Authors, Version links, Host, Unreleased, Release branches, Draft approval) as a Setting with no answer, and gives the words "use the default changelog policy".

evals.name: 22-no-policy-use-defaults
evals.prompt: Use the default changelog policy. Add a changelog entry: fix `slugify` keeping leading spaces (pull request #6).
assertions: [22.1] After the run, `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` holds exactly the title `# Changelog policy`, a blank line, and these 8 lines in this sequence: `- References: commits, pull requests`, `- Notice: required`, `- Authors: on`, `- Version links: release`, `- Host: auto`, `- Unreleased: on`, `- Release branches: release, hotfix`, `- Draft approval: off` (a final newline is permitted).

[22.2] Exactly one new item is in `CHANGELOG.md`. It is under `## Unreleased`, in the group `### Fixed`, is about `slugify` and leading spaces, has the linked reference `[#6](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/6)`, and has no commit reference.
[22.3] The final report names both `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` as changed or new files.
[22.4] `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` is not staged and not in a commit: `git status --porcelain` of the state after shows it as an untracked file.

evals.name: 23-no-policy-all-values
evals.prompt: Set up the changelog policy with these values: References: commits, pull requests. Notice: required. Authors: on. Version links: compare. Host: auto. Unreleased: off. Release branches: release. Draft approval: off. Then add a changelog entry for 1.3.0: fix `slugify` keeping leading spaces (pull request #6).
assertions: [23.1] After the run, `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` holds exactly the title `# Changelog policy`, a blank line, and these 8 lines in this sequence: `- References: commits, pull requests`, `- Notice: required`, `- Authors: on`, `- Version links: compare`, `- Host: auto`, `- Unreleased: off`, `- Release branches: release`, `- Draft approval: off` (a final newline is permitted).
[23.2] `CHANGELOG.md` has no `## Unreleased` heading. Its first section after `# Changelog` is `## [1.3.0] - <run date>`, above `## [1.2.0] - 2026-09-01`.

[23.3] The 1.3.0 entry has a group `### Fixed` with an item about `slugify` and leading spaces. That item has a linked short SHA of a commit of pull request #6 in the form `https://github.com/example/demo/commit/<sha>`, the linked reference `[#6](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/6)`, and the author `(Bob)` after the references.
[23.4] The bottom of `CHANGELOG.md` has the definition `[1.3.0]: https://github.com/example/demo/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0`, and the old `## [1.2.0]` entry and its definition are unchanged.
[23.5] The final report names both `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` as changed or new files.

evals.name: 24-policy-bad-lines
evals.prompt: Add a changelog entry: fix `slugify` keeping leading spaces (pull request #6).
assertions: [24.1] `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` are unchanged, and `git status --porcelain` of the state after is empty.
[24.2] The final report gives line 3 (the prose sentence) and line 6 (`- Notice: always`) as incorrect lines, and gives no other policy line as incorrect.
[24.3] The final report tells the Operator to correct the Changelog policy or to delete it so that a new Changelog policy is set up.
[24.4] The run record shows no question to the Operator: no question-tool call and no question in the final report.

evals.name: 25-policy-missing-settings
evals.prompt: Add a changelog entry: fix `slugify` keeping leading spaces (pull request #6).
assertions: [25.1] After the run, `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` holds exactly the title `# Changelog policy`, a blank line, and these 8 lines in this sequence: `- References: commits, pull requests`, `- Notice: required`, `- Authors: on`, `- Version links: release`, `- Host: auto`, `- Unreleased: on`, `- Release branches: release, hotfix`, `- Draft approval: off` (a final newline is permitted). The first 4 Settings are unchanged.

[25.2] Exactly one new item is in `CHANGELOG.md`. It is under `## Unreleased`, in the group `### Fixed`, is about `slugify` and leading spaces, has the linked reference `[#6](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/6)`, and has no commit reference.
[25.3] The final report names the change to `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` and the 4 added Settings, and names `CHANGELOG.md`.
[25.4] The change to `docs/agents/changelog-policy.md` is not staged and not in a commit.
